exposure: time interval between oocyte retrieval and the day of first frozen-thawed embryo transferred (FET)
cohort: Patients who underwent a freeze-all cycle and subsequent first single blastocyst transfer in artificially cycles
finding: Delayed FET cycles for blastocyst transfer following freeze-all cycles may not improve pregnancy outcomes, and may increase the risk of macrosomia.
mod_finding: The study found that delayed frozen-thawed single blastocyst transfer cycles after a freeze-all cycle did not improve pregnancy outcomes and may increase the risk of macrosomia.
